sa: उद्भ्रान्तहृदयश्चापि विवर्णवदनोऽभवत्। स धुर्यो वै परिस्पन्दन् युगचक्रान्तरं यथा॥
en: Thereupon, the king looked blank, and his heart became agitated, like to a beast of burden moving tortuously when placed within the yoke and wheels.

sa: प्रसीदेच्छामि तेऽरण्ये भवितुं प्रत्यनन्तरः। प्रीत्याभिहितमिच्छामि भव मे प्रत्यनन्तरः॥
en: Be you propitious. It is my wish to remain in the forest with you, and do you say, affectionately, 'Do you remain by my side.'

sa: अभिपेतुस्ततः सर्वे तस्यामात्याः शुचिव्रतम्। अन्तकाले निपतितं ययातिमृषयो यथा॥
en: His counsellors rushed towards that one of pure vows, like the saints making towards Yayati as he was falling on the extinction of his merit.

sa: ततो वैखानसं मार्गमास्थितः सहलक्ष्मणः। व्रतमादिष्टवान् रामः सहायं गुहमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then entering upon the Vānaprastha mode of life, Rāma along with Lakşmaņa assuming the vow of that life, observed to that adherent of his, Guha.

sa: नागानां वध्यमानानामसुराणां च राघव। राक्षसानां दुराधर्षं सत्त्वानां निनदोऽभवत्॥
en: O Rāghava, O you hard to repress, there arose an uproar from serpents, and Asuras, and Rāks asas, and other creatures, that were being slaughtered.

sa: महदुग्रं तपः कृत्वा मां निषेवन्ति मानवाः। देवदानवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः॥
en: The gods, the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, the Uragas, the Rakshasas, and human being succeed in getting me only after practising the severest austerities.

sa: सद्भावनिरताश्चान्ये केचित् संशयिते स्थिताः। दुःखादन्ये सुखादन्ये ध्यानमित्यपरे जनाः॥
en: Some are devoted to goodness. Others are established on doubt. Some are for pleasure. Some are for pain. Others people say that it is meditation.

sa: संहरस्व पुनर्देव रूपमक्षय्यमुत्तमम्। पुनस्त्वां स्वेन रूपेण द्रष्टुमिच्छामि शाश्वतम्॥
en: Do you withdraw this excellent and indestructible forin of yours. I wish to see you now in your own (human) form which too, is eternal.

sa: एवं विधे त्वगर-त्यस्य क्रतवः कृताः। सहस्राक्षस्तदा वर्तमाने तथाध्वरे। न ववर्ष सहस्राक्षस्तदा भरतसत्तम॥ ततः कर्मान्तरे राजन्नगस्त्यस्य महात्मनः। कथेयमभिनिवृत्ता मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्॥ नववर्ष अगस्त्यो यजमानोऽसौ ददात्यन्नं विमत्सरः।
en: Numerous other ascetics at that times celebrated large sacrifices. As Agastya, however, was engaged in that sacrifice of his, the thousand-eyed Indra, O best of the Bharatas, ceased to pour rain (on the Earth. At the intervals, O king, of the sacrificial rites, this talk took place among those Rishis of purified souls about the great Agastya, viz., 'This Agastya, engaged in sacrifice, is making gifts of food with heart purged of pride and vanity.

sa: तं चापि वशमानीय किरीटी पुरुषर्षभः। निषादराज्ञो विषयमेकलव्यस्य जग्मिवान्॥
en: Bringing him under his control the diademdecked Arjuna, that foremost of men, went to the kingdom of the Nishada king, viz., the son of Ekalavya.

sa: अक्रोधः सत्यवचनमहिंसा दम आर्जवम्। अद्रोहोऽनभिमानश्च ह्रीस्तितिक्षा दमः शमः॥ यस्मिन्नेतानि दृश्यन्ते न चाकार्याणि भारत। स्वभावतो निविष्टानि तत्पात्रं मानमर्हति॥
en: Absence of anger, truthfulness of speech, abstention from injury, sincerity, peacefulness of conduct, the absence of pride, modesty, renunciation, selfcontrol and tranquillity or contentment of soul he in whom these are by nature, and in whom there are no wicked acts, should be considered as a proper object. Such a person deserves honours.

sa: गुरुं शिष्यो वरयेद् गोप्रदाने स वै गन्ता नियतं स्वर्गमेव। विधिज्ञानं सुमहान् धर्म एष विधिं ह्याद्यं विधयः संविशन्ति॥
en: The disciple should, in the matter of making gifts of kine, select his preceptor. Such a disciple is sure to go to Heaven every time. The selection of a preceptor is considered as a high duty by persons knowing the ordinances. This is, indeed, the initial ordinance. All other ordinances depend upon it.

sa: स मन्यमानो विमुखं पितरं बभ्रुवाहनः। शरैराशीविषाकारैः पुनरेवार्दयद् बली॥
en: The powerful Babhruvahana, thinking that his father was no longer able to face him, again afflicted him with many arrows resembling snakes of dreadful poison.

sa: दत्त्वा विप्रस्य दानानि विविधानि समाहितः। मन:समाधिसंयुक्तः सुगति प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: By making with a concentrated mind, gifts of various kinds to Brahmana, and concentrating the mind (on the deity), one attains to an auspicious end.

sa: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मो गृहस्थेषु विधीयते। तमहं वर्तयिष्यामि सर्वभूतहितं शुभम्॥
en: The Religion laid down for the householder has action for its chief characteristic. Auspicious, and beneficial to all creatures, I shall explain it to you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच बृहस्पतिसमं बुद्ध्या क्षमया ब्रह्मणः समम्। पराक्रमे शक्रसममादित्यसमतेजसम्॥ गाङ्गेयमर्जुनेनाजौ निहतं भूरितेजसम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽन्यैश्च पर्यपृच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Equal to Brihaspati in intelligence and Brahman himself in forgiveness, resembling Shakra in prowess and the Sun in energy, Bhishma the son of Ganga, of infinite might, had been defeated in battle by Arjuna. Accompanied by his brothers and many other people king, Yudhishthira asked him these questions.

sa: आदिमध्यावसानान्तं सृज्यमानमचेतनम्। न गुणा विदुरात्मानं सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः॥
en: The qualities, which are created repeatedly, do not know themselves, being unintelligent, as entities to be created and gifted with a beginning, middle, and end.

sa: उत्पेदिरे महावाता दारुणाश्च दिने दिने। वृष्ण्यन्धकविनाशाय बहवो लोमहर्षणाः॥
en: Day by day strong winds blew, and many were the evil omens which arose, awful and foreboding the destruction of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas.

sa: ततो दिग्वाससं धीमान् मातङ्ग मलपङ्किनम्। अपश्यत मरौ तस्मिश्वयूथपरिवारितम्॥
en: The intelligent Rishi then saw in that desert a naked hunter (of the Chandala class), all besmeared with dirt, surrounded by a pack of dogs.

sa: अमृतप्रसवां भूमिं प्राप्नोति पुरुषो ददत्। नास्ति भूमिसमं दानं नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः। नास्ति सत्यसमो धर्मो नास्ति दानसमो निधिः॥
en: A person by making a gift of earth wins in his next lifenectargiving earth. There is no gift equal to a gift of earth. There is none worthy of greater respect than the mother. There is no duty higher than truth. There is no riches more valuable than that which is given away.

sa: महदश्वसमायुक्तं बुद्धिसंयमनं रथम्। समारुह्य स भूतात्मा समन्तात् परिधावति॥
en: The individual soul, mounting the chariot to which big horses are yoked and which has the understanding for the reins, drives about on all sides.

sa: निमिस्तु कृत्वा शौचानि विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। संतापमगमत् तीवं पुत्रशोकपरायणः॥
en: His father Nimi, having performed the purificatoy rites according to sanctioned rites, because stricken with great grief, thinking continually of the loss of his son.

sa: ततः पश्चान्महाराज कृमियोनौ प्रजायते। कृमिर्विंशतिवर्षाणि भूत्वा जायति मानुषः॥
en: After that, О king, he has to take birth as a vile vermin. Living as a vermin for twenty years, he regains the human form.

sa: गम्यतां साधयिष्याप्तो वयं ह्यग्निभयात् सुराः। एतावदुक्त्वा मण्डूकस्त्वरितो जलमाविशत्॥
en: As regards ourselves, we shall fly from this place, O celestials, from fear of Agni! Having said this much, the frog dived into the water.

sa: आपो नित्यं प्रदेयास्ते पुण्यं ह्येतदनुत्तमम्। प्रपाश्च कार्या दानार्थं नित्यं ते द्विजसत्तम। भुक्तेऽप्यन्नं प्रदेयं तु पानीयं वै विशेषतः॥
en: Do you always make gifts of water. This act is full great merit, О best of twice born persons, for making such gifts you should put up resting places along the roads for the distribution of water. After one has eaten, the gift to one should especially be made of water for drink.

sa: भीम! पर्याप्नुहि भयादिति चैवाभिवाशती॥ समन्ततः परिक्षिप्ता माताभन्मे दवाग्निना।
en: She must have also said, O Bhima, save me from this danger! when she, my mother, was surrounded on all sides y that dreadful fire.

sa: द्रौपदीमुत्तरां चैव पृथां चाप्यवलोककः। समाश्वासयितुं चापि क्षत्रिया निहतेश्वराः॥
en: Indeed, that hero came for seeing Draupadi, Uitara and Pritha and for comforting those renowned Kshatriya-ladies who had been bereft of many of their protectors.

sa: रमणीयः समुद्देशो गङ्गातीरमिदं शुभम्। किंचित्कालं व्रतपरो निवत्स्यामीह पार्थिव॥
en: This spot on the banks of Ganga is very charming and auspicious. I shall, observing a vow, live for a little while here, O king.

sa: इमं मन्त्रं जपञ्छ्राद्धे यताहारो ह्यकोपनः। बलदेवप्रभृतयो ये नागा बलवत्तराः॥ अनन्ता ह्यक्षया नित्यं भोगिनः सुमहाबलाः। तेषां कुलोद्भवा ये च महाभूता भुजङ्गेमाः॥ ते मे बलिं प्रतीच्छन्तु बलतेजोऽभिवृद्धये। यदा नारायणः श्रीमानुज्जहार वसुंधराम्॥ तद् बलं तस्य देवस्य धरामुद्धरतस्तथा। एवमुक्त्वा बलिं तत्र वल्मीके तु निवेदयेत्॥ गजेन्द्रकुसुमाकीर्णं नीलवस्त्रानुलेपनम्।
en: an Renouncing anger, and living on regulated diet, one should make these offerings at a Shraddha, uttering these Mantras, Let Baladeva and other Nagas endued with great strength, let other powerful snakes of huge bodies that are indestructible and eternal and let all the other great snakes that have taken their birth in their family, inake vali offerings to me for the increase of my strength and energy. Indeed, let my strength be as great as that of the blessed Narayana when he raised the submerged Earth. Uttering these Mantras, one should make Bali offerings upon anthill. After sunset, offerings of raw sugar and rice should be made on anthill selected. The anthill should Previously be strewn with Gajendra flowers. Offerings should also be made of blue clothes and fragrant unguents.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि जघानाशु बाणेनैकेन वीर्यवान्। योगेनात्मानमाविश्य सिद्धिं परमिकां गतः॥
en: Gifted with energy, he speedily killed all the senses with one arrow, having entered by Yoga into his soul and thereby acquired the highest success.

sa: त्रियुगौ पुण्डरीकाक्षौ वासुदेवधनञ्जयौ। विदितौ नारदादेतौ मम व्यासाञ्ज पार्थिव॥
en: Indeed, Vasudeva and Dhananjaya, having like lotus petals, practised severe austerities for three entire cycles. I have learnt this from Narada and Vyasa, O king.

sa: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणो योगो ज्ञानं संन्यासलक्षणम्। तस्माज्ज्ञानं पुरस्कृत्य संन्यसेदिह बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Devotion has acts for its characteristic. Knowledge is the characteristic of renunciation. Therefore, kecping knowledge before his view, the man of understanding should practise renunciation.

sa: ततो हि पावनात्पङ्क्त्याः पङ्क्तिपावन उच्यते। क्रोशादर्घतृतीयाच्च पावयेदेक एव हि॥ ब्रह्मदेयानुसंतान इति ब्रह्मविदो विदुः। अनृत्विगनुपाध्यायः स चेदग्रासनं व्रजेत्॥
en: And because they purity all who sit in the line, therefore are they called purifiers of lines. Utterers of Brahma say that even a single person who happens to be the descendant of ancestors who were teachers of the Veda and who is himself a Vedic teacher, purifies full seven miles around him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। गोभिर्नृपेह संवादं श्रिया भरतसत्तम॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old story, O king of the conversation between kine and godless of prosperity, O best of the Bharatas.

sa: तव प्रसादसंवृत्तमिदं सर्वं महामुने। नैतच्चित्रं तु भगवंस्त्वयि सत्यपराक्रम॥
en: All this, O great ascetic, is due to your favour, Indeed, there is nothing wonderful in all this, O holy Rishi of power ever unbaffled.

sa: सदा च प्रातरुत्थाय कृतजप्यः शुचिर्नृपः॥ आशास्ते पाण्डुपुत्राणां समरेष्वपराजयम्।
en: Rising every day at early dawn, he purified himself and went through his recitations, and then blessed the Pandavas by wishing them victory in battle.

sa: स्वदोषकोपनाद् रोगं लभते मरणान्तिकम्। अपि वोद्वन्धनादीनि परीतानि व्यवस्थति॥
en: From such excitement of the faults in his body, he gets disease ultimately bringing on death. Sometimes the person engages in unnatural deeds like strangling.

sa: त्रीनश्चमेधानत्र त्वं सम्प्राप्य बहुदक्षिणान्। ज्ञातिवध्याकृतं पापं प्रहास्यसि नराधिप॥
en: Acquiring the merits then of three HorseSacrifices, each with profuse presents, you shall be freed, O king, from the sin of having killed your kinsmen.

sa: द्रौपदीप्रमुखाश्चैव सर्वाः कौरवयोषितः॥ न्यायतः श्वशुरे वृर्ति प्रयुज्य प्रययुस्ततः।
en: Then all the ladies of the Kaurava household, headed by Draupadi, adored their father-in-law according to the rites laid down in the scriptures, and departed.

sa: प्रसादयामहे विद्वन् भवन्तं प्रणता वयम्। अनुग्रहार्थमस्माकमियं गौः प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥
en: We propitiate you, O you of great learning. We surrender ourselves to you. Do you, for showing us favour, take back from us this cow.

sa: कूपेऽऽत्मानमधःशीर्षमपश्यं पतितश्च ह। तिर्यग्योनिमनुप्राप्तं न च मामजहात् स्मृतिः॥
en: Falling down I found myself, with head downwards, within this well changed into a creature of the intermediate order, Memory, however, did not leave me.

sa: तमनार्यं नृशंसं च विस्मृत्यास्य पितामहम्॥ आगस्कारिणमत्यर्थं प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि
en: Forgetting his disreputable and cruel grandfather, who offended against you so highly, it is but fit that you should extend your grace towards this child.

sa: तस्मान्न वाच्यं ह्येकेन बहुज्ञेनापि संशये। प्रजापतिमपाहाय स्वयम्भुवमृते प्रभुम्॥
en: Therefore, when a doubt arises, no person, however wise, should singly decide the matter, unless he be the powerful and self-born Lord himself of creatures,

sa: श्राद्धे त्वथ महाराज परीक्षेद् ब्राह्मणान् बुधः। कुलशीलवयोरूपैर्विद्ययाभिजनेन च॥
en: In Shraddhas, however, O king, the man of intelligence should examine the Brahmanas. Such examination should be about their birth, conduct, age, appearance, and learning.

sa: ध्यानयोगेन शुद्धेन निर्ममा निरहंकृताः। आप्नुवन्ति महात्मानो महान्तं लोकमुत्तमम्॥
en: Those great ones, however, who are devoid of mineness and freed from egoism through the pure contemplation of Yoga, acquire the great and highest regions.

sa: ततः प्रमुदित: सर्वो जनस्तद् वनमञ्जसा। विवेश सुमहानादैरापूर्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then all the men became filled with joy and quickly entered the forest, filling it with loud sounds of joy, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: अथेन्द्रोऽहमिति ज्ञात्वां अहंकारं समाविशत्। सर्वाश्चैव क्रियास्तस्य पर्यहीयन्त भूपतेः॥
en: Sometime after, Nahusha realised his position as the king of the deities. This filled him with pride. From that time all his deeds were suspended.

sa: सर्वविद्यस्तु चक्षुष्मानपि यादृशतादृशम्। तपस्विनं तथैवाहस्ताभ्यां कार्यं सदा नमः॥
en: One gifted with all knowledge and therefore, having true vision and an ascetic of whatever kind, are equal. One should always bow to these two.

sa: गोकर्णमथ चायाद्य प्रभासमपि जग्मिवान्। ततो द्वारवती रम्यां वृष्णिवीराभिमालिताम्॥
en: Arrived at Gokarna, he went thence to Prabhasa. Then he proceeded to the beautiful city of Dvaravati protected by the heroes of the Vrishni race.

sa: इदमाख्यातवांश्चापि ममाख्यानं महामुनिः। मार्कण्डेयः पुरा राजन् गङ्गाकूले कथान्तरे॥
en: In course of conversation, o king, on a former occasion, the great ascetic Markandeya had described to me this history on the banks of Ganga.

sa: सप्तर्षयो वालखिल्यास्तथैव च मरीचिपाः। अमांसभक्षणं राजन् प्रशंसन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: The highly wise seven celestial Rishis, the Valakhillyas, and those Rishi, who drink the rays of the sun, all speak highly of abstention from ineat.

sa: तथैव देवी गान्धारी वल्कलाजिनधारिणी। कुन्त्या सह महाराज समानव्रतचारिणी॥
en: Queen Gandhari also, O monarch, along with Kunti, put on barks of trees and deerskins, and began to observe the same vows as her husband.

sa: विश्वामित्रस्य तत्रैव तीर्थं भरतसत्तम। तत्र स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मण्यमधिगच्छति॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, there is a Tirtha of Vishvamitra. O best of men, bathing there, one obtains the status of a Brahmana.

sa: सप्तमाच्चापि दिवसादमावास्या भविष्यति। संग्रामो युज्यतां तस्यां तामाहुः शक्रदेवताम्॥
en: In seven days will there be full moon and on that day let us engage in fight; for this is the day favorite to Shakra.

sa: पूरयित्वा नरव्याघ्र रुधिरेणेति विश्रुतम्। पितरस्तर्पिताः सर्वे तथैव प्रपितामहाः॥
en: foremost of men, we have heard that he filled them with their blood. He offered that (blood) as oblations to all his sires and grandsires.

sa: श्वसद्भिर्मुच्यमानास्तु दिग्गजैरिह मारुताः॥ आगच्छन्ति महाराज ततस्तिष्ठन्ति वै प्रजाः।
en: O king, having been thus let out by these clephants, these winds come over to this earth, and for their coming creatures breathe and live.

sa: शृणु राजन्यथाकाले प्राप्तो बालस्य संक्षयः॥ श्रुत्वा कर्तव्यतां राजन्कुरुष्वरघुनन्दन।
en: Hear, o king, why this boy has met with untimely death. And hearing this, O descendant or Raghu, do you settle what you think proper.

sa: तथा भीष्मः पाण्डवेयास्तापयामास भारत॥ तथा चैनं पराक्रान्तमालोक्य मधुसूदनः।
en: So did, O Bharata, Bhishma then afflict the ranks of the Pandavas. Then beholding Bhishma thus display his prowess in battle, the slayer of Madhu,

sa: महतश्चूर्णितान् पश्य ये हासन्त महोदधिम्। सुवर्णधारिणा नित्यमवशप्ता द्विजातिना॥
en: See, the sixty thousand sons of Sagara, who came here to worship the Ocean, have all been pulverised by the Brahmana Kapila of golden hue.

sa: ब्रह्म क्षत्रं च तत्सर्वं यत्पूर्वमवरं च यत्॥ युगयोरुभयोरासीत्समवीर्यसमन्वितम्।
en: In the golden age the Brāhmaṇas were more powerful than the Kșatriyas. But in the Tretā age the Brāhmaṇas and the Ksatriyas were equally powerful.

sa: तौ व्यवाहरतां तत्र महात्मानौ महाबलौ। अन्योन्यमभिगर्जन्तौ गोष्ठेषु वृषभाविव॥
en: He then came upon Susharma, the king of Trigartas mounted on a golden chariot; there those two high-souled and highly powerful (heroes) struck (each other)

sa: चाराणां रावणः श्रुत्वा प्राप्तं रामं महाबलम्। जातोद्वेगोऽभवत्किचिच्छार्दूलं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the spies, that Rama, accompanied by a mighty army, had arrived (there), Rāvana was a little agitated and spoke to Sardula.

sa: स भवान् गमनादेव साधयिष्यत्यसंशयम्। इष्टमर्थं महाबाहो धर्मराजस्य केवलम्॥
en: Therefore you will the moment you go there, accomplish without doubt the only object desired by the virtuous king, O you of long arms. are

sa: हरिभिर्वध्यमानश्च याचमानः कृताञ्जलिः। राघवेण परित्रातो मामेति च यदृच्छया॥
en: And, having been belaboured by the monkeys, I, on craving his kindness with joined hands, was, at his pleasure, rescued by Rāghava, with, Don't, don't!

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु गाङ्गेयः पाण्डवानिदमब्रवीत्। धृतराष्ट्रमुखांश्चपि सर्वोश्च सुहृदस्तथा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, the son of Ganga once more addressed the Pandavas headed by Dhritarashtra, and other friends and wellwishers of his.

sa: मुख्यानमात्यानुत्सृज्य यो निहीनान् निषेवते। स घोरामापदं प्राप्य नोत्तारमधिगच्छति॥
en: He, who abandoning his principal advisers according to the injunctions of inferior ones, meets with grave dangers and does not come out of them safe.

sa: 'भगवते निवेद्य पूर्वमपरं चरामि। तेन वृत्तिं कल्पयामि' इति॥
en: Being thus questioned, he answered to his preceptor, “Sir, after giving you all I get by begging, I go again to beg to support myself.”

sa: सोऽहं पितुर्वचः श्रुत्वा शासनाद् ब्रह्मवादिनः। करिष्यामि न संदेहस्ताटकावधमुत्तमम्॥
en: Therefore, commanded by that upholder of the Veda, I, agreeably to my father's mandate, will, without doubt, bring about that welcome event-the death of Tataka.

sa: शमे शर्म भवेत् तात सर्वस्य जगतस्तथा। ह्रीमानसि कुले जातः श्रुतवाननृशंसवान्। धीमतः॥ तिष्ठ तात पितुः शास्त्रे मातुश्च भरतर्षभ॥
en: In peace, there will be your benefit, my dear friend, as also that of the entire world; be endued with modesty, for you are born in a noble family, and be learned and human; therefore, my dear friend, do you follow the commands of your father and mother. O best among the Bharatas.

sa: संस्तूयमानः सूतैश्च मागधैश्च महायशाः। पूजयानश्च तान् सर्वान् सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरः॥
en: He heard sweet words uttered by the assembled inhabitants of various countries. moon That illustrious one was applauded and eulogised by the bards and minstrels.

sa: श्रुतवृत्तोपसम्पन्नः सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः। दौष्कुलेया दुरात्मानो नृशंसा निरपत्रपाः॥
en: You are endue with learning and with good habits of life. Whereas these that are born in low families are wicked souled, Inhuman and shameless.

sa: सौतिरुवाच श्रुत्वैतद्वचनं शक्रः प्रोवाचामृतरक्षिणः। महावीर्यबल: पक्षी हर्तुं सोममिहोद्यतः॥
en: Sauti said : Having heard this, Indra spoke to those that guarded the Ambrosia, "A greatly powerful bird has determined to take away the Soma;

sa: असुरास्तेन दैतेयाः सुरास्तेनादितेः सुताः। हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताश्चासन् वारुणीग्रहणात् सुराः॥
en: Hence Diti's son go by the name of Asuras; and Aditi's by that of Suras. And the celestials became exceeding glad, on having accepted Vāruņi.

sa: वैरस्य च गतः पारं त्वमिहान्यैः सुदुर्गमम्। अशक्यमेतदन्येन सम्पादयितुमीदृशम्॥
en: You have brought these hostilities, to a close which none could do! This feat of yours is incapable of being done by any other warrior!

sa: ततो निःपुरुषं शैलं हिमसंरुद्धकन्दरम्। अगम्यं मनसाप्यन्यैस्तस्याचख्यौ स कश्यपः॥
en: Kashyapa told him of a mountain without human beings, with caves and dales, always covered with snow and inaccessible by ordinary men even in thought.

sa: संजय उवाच संनिवृत्ते जनौघे तु शाल्वो म्लेच्छगणाधिपः। अभ्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धः पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्॥ आस्थाय सुमहानागं प्रभिन्नं पर्वतोपमम्। दृप्तमरावतप्रख्यममित्रगणमर्दनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said After the (Kuru) army had been gathered Shalya, the king of the Mlechchhas, filled with rage, rushed against the large army of the Pandavas, riding on a gigantic clephant, with temporal juice trickling, looking like a hill, elated with pride, resembling Airavata himself and capable of crushing large numbers of foes.

sa: तच्छिरो न्यपतद् भूमौ तपनीयविभूषितम्। भ्राजयत् तं रणोद्देशं बालसूर्यसमप्रभम्॥
en: Then that head fell down on ground beautifying the field of battle-head that was adorned with gold and that equalled in effulgence the newly-risen sun.

sa: यावन्मातरमापृच्छे सीतां जानुनयाम्यहम्। ततोऽद्यैव गमिष्यामि दण्डकानां महद् वनम्॥
en: Excuse me until I ask my mother, and comfort Sītā; even this very day shall I wend my way to the great forest of Dandaka.

sa: तत्रेयमनुमात्रा मे भीमसेन विवक्षिता। नैकान्तसिद्धिर्वक्तव्या शत्रुभिः सह संयुगे॥
en: In this sense, O Bhimasena, did I speak; and I did not mean that in a battle with the enemy; success would be absolutely theirs.

sa: यौयुधानि सरस्वत्यां पुत्रं सात्यकिन: प्रियम्। न्यवेशयत धर्मात्मा वृद्धबालपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: The dear son of Yuyudhana, with a number of old men and children and women, the righteous-souled Arjuna established on the banks of the Sarasvati.

sa: उचितं च महाबाहुर्न जहौ हर्षमात्मवान्। शारदः समुदीर्णांशुश्चन्द्रस्तेज इवात्मजम्॥
en: Like to the rays of the fully brilliant autumnal moon, that hero of mighty arms, having control over himself, did not forsake his native cheerfulness.

sa: सुकुमारो महासत्त्वः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षस्तरुणः प्रियदर्शनः॥ प्रत्याश्वस्य मुहूर्तं तु कालं परमदुर्मनाः। ससाद सहसा तोत्रैर्हदि विद्ध इव द्विपः॥
en: And then taking heart for a while, that tenderfamed one possessed of immense strength, gifted with leonine shoulders and length of arms, having expansive eyes resembling white lotuses, young in years, and endowed with a handsome presence, afflicted with great grief, was overpowered, like an elephant wounded in the heart with a goad.

sa: ततस्तं काञ्चने पीठे समुत्थाप्योपवेश्य च। अब्रुवन्त्यो महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे॥
en: Raising him then they caused him to be seated on a golden seat. The ladies sat around that great one, giving expression to their feelings.

sa: अनल्पेन प्रयत्नेन निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा। मयेन मनसा सृष्टं पातालतलमाश्रितम्॥
en: It having been built with no little care by the divine architect (Vishvakarama) and planned by Maya (Danava) was placed in these nether regions-the Patalam.

sa: यत्र स क्षत्रियः पौष्यस्तमुपेत्यासीनमपश्यदुत्तङ्कः। स उत्तङ्कस्तमुपेत्याशीभिरभिनंद्योवाच॥ प्रत्युवाच पौष्यः
en: He arrived at the palace of king Paushya who was seated on his throne. Uttanka went to him and saluted him; and pronouncing blessings said,

sa: एते पञ्च महाभागा गन्धर्वाः पावकप्रभाः। द्रौपद्यास्तनया राजन् युष्माकममितौजसः॥
en: These five highly blessed Gandharvas gifted with the effulgence of fire, and endued with great energy, were O king, the sons of Draupadi and yourself.

sa: न्यविशन्त ततः सर्वे परिगृह्य सरस्वतीम्। तापसास्ते महात्मानो भृगुश्रेष्ठपुरस्कृताः॥
en: All of them, namely those great-souled ascetics with that foremost among the race of Bhrigu at their head, having reached the river Sarasvati, encamped there.

sa: पूर्वराजर्षिवृत्त्या हि वनवासोऽभिधीयते। प्रजा निक्षिप्य पुत्रेषु पुत्रवत् परिपालने॥
en: Dwelling into the forest is permitted after making over(the charge of) the subjects to (the hands of the) sons, as did the Rājarsis of old.

sa: अनायुष्या भवेदीर्ध्या तस्मादीलुं विवर्जयेत्॥ अनायुष्यं दिवा स्वप्नं तथाभ्युदितशायिता।
en: Malice always shortens life. Hence, one should always abstain from entertaining malice. Sleep at day time shortens life. To sleep after the sunrise shortens life.

sa: स ददर्श ततः श्रीमान् सुग्रीवं हेमपिङ्गलम्। सुसंवीतमवष्टब्धं दीप्यमानमिवानलम्॥
en: And that highly effulgent one espied Sugrīva, having a golden yellow hue, tightly clothed, standing firm on the earth and shining like to burning gold.

sa: अर्चयित्वा महादेवमश्वमेधफलं लभेत्। देव्यास्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Worshipping there Mahadeva, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha. Bathing in the Devi Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: कुञ्जरैश्च गजारोहा ययुः शैलनिभैस्तथा। सपादरक्षैः संयुक्ताः सान्तरायुधिका ययुः॥
en: The warriors who fought from the backs of elephants proceeded on elephants as huge as hills. The infanty also set out, together with the reserves.

sa: अनुरक्तश्च भक्तश्च लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्॥ अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली। रामस्य दक्षिणो बाहुनित्यं प्राणो बहिश्चरः॥
en: His brother is endued with mighty energy, and in merit, is of equal prowess, and he is devoted to his brother, and bear him regard; the puissant one is named Laksmana. And wrathful and invincible and victorious, and powerful, and intelligent and mighty, (he) is Rāma's right-arı-his life ranging externally.

sa: प्रेष्यतां चैव राधेयस्तेषामागमनाय वै। तैस्तैः प्रकारैः संनीय पात्यन्तामाप्तकारिभिः॥
en: Or, O son of Radha, send messengers to bring them here, so that getting them here, we might kill them by some means or other.

sa: संतस्तार शुभां शय्यां दभैदूर्यसंनिभैः। ततो माल्येन विधिवल्लजैर्गन्धैः सुमङ्गलैः॥
en: Spread an auspicious bed made of Kushamass of the hue of lapises. Thereafter, with garlands of flowers, fried paddy and perfumes and other auspicious articles.

sa: तेषां शरीरावयवैः शरीरैश्च विशाम्पते॥ न्यग्रोधमण्डलं सर्वं संछन्नं सर्वतोऽभवत्।
en: With the limbs and bodies, O king, of the slain crows, the ground covered by the spreading branches of the banian, overspread on all sides.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तो मात्रा तु रामो भ्रातरमब्रवीत्। प्राञ्जलिं प्रहमासीनमभिवीक्ष्य स्मयन्निव।॥
en: Having been thus addressed by his mother, Rāma looking at his brother(Lakşmaņa), seated in humble guise with clasped hands, with smile spoke to him, saying.

sa: नित्यानुषक्तवैरा हि भ्रातरो देवदानवाः। परपक्षण सम्बन्धं रोचयिष्याम्यहं कथम्॥
en: The gods and the Danavas, though brothers, are in open enmity with each other and how can I approve of an alliance with the enemies.

sa: अभयं च पुनर्दत्तं त्वयैवैषां सुरोत्तमा तस्मादिन्द्रो भवानस्तु त्रैलोक्यस्याभयंकरः॥
en: O foremost of celestials, you have removed all their fears, therefore become the Indra of the three worlds and thus remove their cause of apprehension.

sa: द्वितीयं पारणं प्राप्य सोऽतिरात्रफलं लभेत्। सर्वरत्नमयं दिव्यं विमानमधिरोहति॥
en: When second Parana is reached, the hearer acquires the fruits of the Atiratha now, Indeed, he ascends a celestial car made entirely of costly gems.

sa: दुर्योधनं त्रिभिर्वाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्। स तत शुशुभे राजा शिखरैगिरिराडिव॥
en: Pierced Duryodhana on this two arms and breast, with three arrows; but O king, thus struck the latter wavered not, like a monarch of mountains.

sa: गाधेर्दुहितरं प्राप्य पौत्रीं तव महातपाः। ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रधर्माणं पुत्रमुत्पादयिष्यति॥
en: Having obtained for wife the daughter of Gadhi and your granddaughter, O king, that great ascetic will beget a twiceborn son gifted with Kshatriya accomplishments.

sa: ते मुहूर्तं तु विश्रम्य लब्धतोयैहयोत्तमैः। सूर्यास्तमनवेलायां समासेदुर्महद् वनम्॥
en: Having rested for a little while, they entered that great forest, proceeding on their cars drawn by their excellent horses whose thirst had been satisfied.

sa: गौतमस्य महर्षर्य आचार्यस्य शरद्वतः। कार्तिकेय इवाजेयः शरस्तम्बात् सुतोऽभवत्॥
en: The son of the great Rishi Gautama, or the preceptor Sharadvata, born on a clump of health, is invincible as the war god Kartikeya himself.

sa: किमर्थं चापि निक्षिप्य दूरे बलमिहागतः। कस्मान्नेहोपयातोऽसि सबलः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Why did you coming higher, leave your army at a distance:? And, you man of men, why did you not come accompanied with your forces?

sa: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही प्रियाहाँ प्रियवादिनी। प्रणयादेव संक्रुद्धा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Being addressed thus, Vaidehi, beloved and sweet speeched, spoke to her husband the following words, offended as it were on account of her great affection.

sa: ततः स्वस्तिपुरं गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O king, then the pilgrim should go to the Tirtha, called Sashtipura. Walking round it, he obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: अत्राहं पुरुषव्याघ्रं गुरुसत्कारकारिणम्। आर्य द्रक्ष्यामि संहृष्टं महर्षिमिव राघवम्॥
en: Even here shall I with a delighted heart see that foremost of men, the noble Rāghava resembling a Maharși, ever engaged in serving his superiors.

sa: अस्ति मास: प्रतिनिधिर्यथा प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। पूतिकामिव सोमस्य तथेदं क्रियतामिति॥
en: The wise men have said that a month is (but) a substitute for a year, as Pritika is considered as a substitute for the Soma.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गच्छेत् भरतर्षभ। तीर्थं कुरुवरश्रेष्ठ त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥ दमीति नाम्ना विख्यातं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा उपासन्ते महेश्वरम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O foremost of the Kurus, having walked round it, one should go to the Tirtha, celebrated all over the three worlds. It is known by the name of Drimi, which is capable of cleansing off all sins and where the celestials including including Brahma worshipped Maheshvara (Shiva).

sa: व्याजेन चरते धर्ममर्थ व्याजेन रोचते। व्याजेन सिध्यमानेषु धनेषु द्विजसत्तम॥ तत्रैव रमते बुद्धिस्तत: पापं चिकीर्षति। सुहद्भिर्वार्यमाणश्च पण्डितैश्च द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, practising virtue with hypocracy, they remain satisfied in acquiring wealth by dishonourable means. And with the wealth thus acquired, their intelligence becomes attached to the evil ways; they were then filled with the desire to commit sins. O foremost of Brahmanas, when their friends and the learned men remonstrate.

sa: एष पन्थाः कुरुश्रेष्ठ सौगन्धिकवनाय ते। द्रक्ष्यसेधनदोद्यानं रक्षितं यक्षराक्षसैः॥
en: O foremost of Kurus, this way will lead you to Saugandhika (forest). You will see the gardens of Kubera, guarded by the Yakshasas and Rakshasas.

sa: बलिहोमनमस्कारैर्मन्त्रैश्च भरतर्षभ। दैवतानि प्रसादं हि भक्त्या दुर्वन्ति भारत।॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O descendant of Bharata, men gratify the celestials by offerings, homas, sacrifices, reverential salutations, recitations of Mantras and veneration.

sa: स्थूणासहस्रैर्वृहतीं शतद्वारा सभां मम। मनोरमां दर्शनीयामाशु कुर्वन्तु शिल्पिनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said. Let artifices be employed to crect without delay a delightful, charming and spacious Sabha with one hundred doors and with one thousand pillars.

sa: मन्यसे वा सभामेतामानीतामेकवाससम्। अधर्मेणेति तत्रापि शृणु मे वाक्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: If you consider it wrong to bring her in the Sabha attired in only one piece of cloth, listen to the excellent words I say.

sa: ततः संवत्सरेऽतीते हतौजसमवस्थितम्। निर्मदं दुःखितं दृष्ट्वा पितरो राममब्रुवन्॥
en: When one year passed away, seeing (Parshu) Rama deprived of prowess, his pride gone and himself in great affliction, the Pitris thus spoke to him,

sa: तदयं पाण्डुपुत्रेण व्यसने वर्तता भृशम्। समाहूतेन कितवैरास्थितौ द्रौपदीपणः॥
en: This son of Pandu (Yudhisthira), white madly engaged in one of these vicious acts (namely gambling) and urged thereto by dec sitful gamblers, staked Draupadi.

sa: स तैरभिहतो बाणैर्बहुभिस्तेन मोहितः। निश्चेष्टः कौरवश्रेष्ठ प्रद्युम्नोऽभूद् रणाजिरे॥
en: O best of Kurus, thus pierced with numberless arrows and deprived of his consciousness, Pradyumna fell (on his car) motionless in the field of battle.

sa: किमर्थं च भयाच्छक्रस्तस्य बालस्यधीमतः। अनावृष्ट्यां प्रवृत्तायां ववर्ष बलवृत्रहा।॥
en: Why from the fear of that intelligent boy the destroyer of Bala and Vritra Sakra (Indra) poured down rain when a draught was raging? ।

sa: यत्रायजत भूतात्मा पूर्वमेव पितामहः। प्रयागमिति विख्यातं तस्माद् भरतसत्तम॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, in this place, the soul of creatures, the Grandsire (Brahma) formerly performed his sacrifices. It is hence called Prayaga.

sa: तान् रथान् साधुसम्पन्नान् संयुक्ताञ्जवनैर्हयैः॥ आस्थाय रथशार्दूलाः शीघ्रमेव ययुस्ततः।
en: Those foremost of car-warriors, riding on those well-furnished cars drawn by fleet horses, went to the place where the Gandharvas were) without the least delay.

sa: पुनश्च रमणीयेषु वनेषूपवनेषु च॥ दमयन्त्या सह नलो विजहारामरोपमः।
en: Then again Nala passed his days in joy in the company of Damayanti in the woods and the pleasure gardens, even as the immortals themselves.

sa: तत् केसरिमहाजालंधनाधिपतिपालितम्। कुबेरं च महात्मानं यक्षरक्षोगणावृतम्॥ ददृशुर्हष्टरोमाणः पाण्डवाः प्रियदर्शनम्। कुबेरस्तु महासत्त्वान् पाण्डोः पुत्रान् महारथान्॥ आत्तकार्मुकनिस्त्रिंशान् दृष्ट्वा प्रीतोऽभवत् तदा। देवकार्यं चिकीर्षन् स हृदयेन तुतोष ह॥
en: The Pandavas then, with their hair standing on the end and with delight beheld that mighty array of horses maintained by the lord of wealth and also the noble-minded and graceful Kubera himself surrounded by the Yakshas and the Rakshasas. Kubera too, seeing those mighty car-warriors, the sons of Pandu, gifted with great strength and equipped with bows and swords, became pleased; and desirous of performing the task of the celestials was glad at heart.

sa: यत्र देवास्तपस्तत्त्वा दैत्या ब्रह्मर्षयस्तथा। दिव्ययोगा महाराज पुण्येन महतान्विताः॥
en: O great king, it was there that the Devas, the Danavas and the Brahmarshi, after performing their ascetic devotions, acquired great virtues and final divinity.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। प्रह्लादस्य च संवादं बलेर्वैरोचनस्य च।।।।
en: Draupadi said : On this is cited as an example the ancient history relating to the conversation between Prahlada and Vali the son of Virochana.

sa: तत्रोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्। अभिगम्य महादेवं वरदं रुद्रमव्ययम्॥ विराजति यथा सोमो मेधैर्मुक्तो नराधिप। जातिस्मरमुपस्पृश्य शुचिः प्रयतमानसः॥
en: O king of kings, bathing in it, one does not meet with any calamity; going to the giver of boons, the great god, the eternal Rudra, where, O king, he always dwells, one shines like the moon emerged from the clouds. Bathing in Jatismara with subdued mind and with purity.

sa: यद्यस्मान् सुमहाराज कृपणान् कर्तुमर्हसि। यावज्जीवमवेक्षस्व वेदधर्मांश्च कृत्स्नशः॥ निकृत्या निकृतिप्रज्ञो हन्तव्य इति निश्चयः। अनुज्ञातस्त्वया गत्वा यावच्छक्ति सुयोधनम्॥ यथैव कक्षमुत्सृष्टो दहेदनिलसारथिः। हनिष्यामि तथा मन्दमनुजानातु मे भवान्॥
en: O great prince, if it behoves you not to make us miserable for life, observe fully the teaching of the Vedas, which lay down, that verily the deceitful ought to be destroyed by the deceitful means. If I but have your command, I would go forth (to Hastinapur) and even as fire consumes heap of grass, would slay that wicked Suyodhana with all my power. It behoves you therefore, O charioteer, to grant me permission."

sa: प्रासादस्थाश्च शिखिनः शालास्थाश्चैव वारणाः। हयाश्च शुश्रुवुस्तस्य रथघोषं पहीपतेः॥
en: The peacocks of the palace, the elephants in the stables and also the horses, all heard the rattle of the car of that monarch (Rituparna).

sa: इति दुर्योधनामात्याः क्रोशन्तो राजगृद्धिनः। आर्ता दीनाप्ततः सर्वे युधिष्ठिरमुपागमन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus crying, the followers of Duryodhana, afflicted with grief and sorrow, came to Yudhishthira desiring to effect the rescue of their king.

sa: तथा भारतधर्मेषुधर्मज्ञैरिह दृश्यते। अहोरात्रं महाराज तुल्यं संवत्सरेण ह॥
en: O Bharata, O great prince, the pious, who are conversant in morality, have regarded a day and a night as equivalent to an entire year.

sa: निजग्राह महाबाहुस्तरसा पौरवेश्वरम्। आकृति कौशिकाचार्य यत्नेन महता ततः॥
en: The mighty armed (hero) soon vanquished and subjugated the Paurava King; and he then with great deal of effort subjugated the preceptor of Kaushika, Akriti.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच दिशो दशोक्ताः पुरुषस्य लोके सहस्रमाहुर्दशपूर्णं शतानि। दशैव मासान् बिभ्रति गर्भवत्यो दशैरका दश दाशा दशार्हाः॥
en: Ashtavakra said : Ten is the number of the cardinal points; ten times hundred make a thousand; ten is the number of months of a woman's conception, ten are the teachers of true knowledge and ten are the haters of knowledge and ten again who are capable of obtaining it.

sa: ततः सम्प्राप्य शैलाचं वीक्षमाणा महारथाः। ददृशुस्ते महेष्वासा भीमसेनमरिंदमाः॥
en: Then those mighty car-warriors and great bowmen and tormentors of foes having reached the summit of the mountain and casting their looks around saw Bhimasena.

sa: स तां विदर्भराजस्य पुत्रार्थं तप्यतस्तपः। निर्मितामात्मनोऽर्थाय मुनिः प्रादान्महातपाः॥
en: That greatly ascetic Rishi then gave that woman created for him to the king of Vidarbha who was performing great asceticism to beget an offspring.

sa: सर्वाल्लोकान् प्रपश्यामि तपसा सत्यविक्रम। इहस्थः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठं पश्यामि श्वेतवाहनम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O greatly powerful Rishis, I see all the worlds by virtue of asceticism. I also see that foremost of the Pandavas Svetavahana (Arjuna).

sa: क्रियतामविशङ्केन मनसा यदि मन्यसे। वरुणं लोकपालानां सुहृद्वाक्यमिदं शृणु॥
en: Should you cherish in you heart (the love of Varuna among the guardians of the worlds, do so without delay. Hear this my friendly advice.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच स एवमुक्तो राजर्षिरुत्तङ्केनापराजितः। उत्तवं कौरवश्रेष्ठ कृताञ्जलिरथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Having been thus addressed by Uttanka, O foremost of the Kurus, that invincible royal sage spoke thus to Uttanka with joined hands.

sa: तुङ्गकारण्यमासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। वेदानध्यापयत् तत्र ऋषिः सारस्वतः पुरा॥
en: Going to Tungakaranya with passions under control and with Brahmacharya life, where in the days of yore, Rishi Sarasvta taught the Vedas to the ascetics.

sa: वित्तं न दद्युः पुरुषाः कथंचित्। प्राप्यार्थकालं च भवेदनर्थ: कथं न तत् स्यादिति तत् कुतः स्यात्॥ कथं न भिद्येत न च स्रवेत न च प्रसिच्येदिति रक्षितव्यम्। अरक्ष्यमाणं शतधा प्रकीर्येद् ध्रुवं न नाशोऽस्ति कृतस्य लोके॥
en: Whatever may be earned by us and others, whether people spend it or not, it would bring us misery when the time would come. Why then people become so anxious to earn wealth? If what is acquired is the result of Fate, then it should be protected, so that is may not be divided nor protected, so that it may not be divided nor lost little by little nor permitted to flow out at once, for if unprotected it may break into one one hundred fragments. But whatever the character of our possession may be, our acts in this world are never lost.

sa: तत एकान्तमुन्नीय मज्जयामास भारत। आजगाम तदा रैभ्यः स्वमाश्रममरिदमा।५।।
en: O descendant of Bharata, then taking him in private, she kept him hidden. O chastiser of foes, (some time after) Raibhya returned to his hermitage.

sa: लोककर्ता महाभाग भगवानच्युतो हरिः। नागभोगेन महता परिरभ्य महीमिमाम्॥
en: The creator of the universe, the greatly blessed one, the exalted and undeteriorating Hari, lay on the hood of the snake encircling the whole world.

sa: ततः प्रीतो महाराज कपिर्लोऽशुमतोऽभवत्। उवाच चैनधर्मात्मा वरदोऽस्मीति भारत॥
en: O great king, O descendant of Bharata, thereupon Kapila was pleased with Angsumana and that virtuous-minded Rishi told him to ask a boon from him.

sa: प्रववौ चानिलो रूक्षश्चण्डः शर्करकर्षणः। अपसव्यानि सर्वाणि मृगपक्षिरुतानि च॥
en: And drawing in (volumes of) grifts the wind began to blow dryly and furiously. In the right all the birds and beasts began to bewail.

sa: तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे पुनरेवान्यतोऽभवत्। शब्दोऽपरो महाराज तत्रापि प्राहरं शरैः॥
en: O great king, when the shout (of the Danavas) ceased at one place, it arose at another place. There also I sent up my arrows.

sa: प्रतार्यमाणा कूटेषु यथा निम्नेषु नित्यशः। शिलातलेषु संत्रस्ता पन्नगेन्द्रवधूरिव॥
en: She flows onward on draggy crests (of hills), descending lower and lower, looking like a frightened female snake lying along the slopes of the hills.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्रधर्मप्रस्थं समाहितः। तत्रधर्मो महाराज नित्यमास्ते युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go with concentrated mind to Dharmaprastha. O great king ever steady in war, Dharma is always present there.

sa: योऽधीते गुरुशुश्रूषां मेधां चाष्टगुणाश्रयामा ब्रह्मचर्येण दाक्ष्येण प्रसवैर्वयसापि च॥
en: Who is endued with devotion to his preceptors, who possesses intellect that stands on the eight attributes, who by his Brahmacharya, ability origin and age.

sa: तदद्भुतमयं दृष्ट्वा नलो राजाथ भारत। दमयन्त्यां विशङ्कां तामुपाकर्षदरिंदमः॥
en: O son of the Bharata race, seeing this greatest wonder, king Nala, the chastiser of foes, threw away all doubts regarding the character of Damayanti.

sa: सर्वत्र मण्डूकवधः क्रियतामिति यो मयार्थी स मां मृतमण्डूकोपायनमदायोपतिष्ठेदिति॥
en: “Kill all frogs wherever they are to be found. Whoever wishes to see me, let him come to me with a dead frog as tribute."

sa: प्रवेण्युत्तरमार्गे तु पुण्ये कण्वाश्रमे तथा। तापसानामरण्यानि कीर्तितानि यथाश्रुति॥
en: It is said that in the region north of it (Payoshini) and near the sacred hermitage of Kanva are many forests inhabited by the ascetics.

sa: उत्तङ्कस्याश्रमाभ्याशे निःश्वसन् पावकार्चिषः। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजा सबलवाहनः॥ उत्तङ्कविप्रसहितः : कुवलाश्वो महीपतिः। पुत्रैः सह महीपालः प्रययौ भरतर्षभ॥
en: While, at this time, he was taking his breath, resting very close to the asylum of the Uttanka, who was like the fire in effulgence, then O ruler of the earth, O foremost of the Bharata race, the great king Kuvalashva departed to that country with the Brahmanas, Uttanka and all his sons.

sa: यत्र देवैस्तपस्तप्तं महदिच्छद्भिराश्रमे। गोकर्ण इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत॥
en: In this hermitage, the celestials had undergone penances with the desire of obtaining salvation. In this region is also Gokarna celebrated over the three worlds.

sa: ते हेमनिष्काभरणा: कुण्डलाङ्गदधारिणः। निहता बह्वशोभन्त पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः॥
en: Adorned as they were with golden ornaments and earrings, they (the Danavas), when killed, looked as beautiful as the Palasha tree when full of blossoms.

sa: भान्त्येते पुष्पविकचाः पुंस्कोकिलकुलाकुलाः। नात्र कण्टकिनः केचिन्न च विद्यन्त्यपुष्पिताः॥
en: This forest is beautified with handsome flowers and maddened male Kokilas, nor there are in it any thorny trees and trees that do not flower.

sa: तां देवसमिति तस्य दासवश्च विशाम्पते। अभ्यागच्छन्नृपवरं ज्ञातुमग्निश्च भारत॥
en: O king, O descendant of Bharata, being desirous of testing the merit of that great king, Vasava (Indra) and Agni came to his celestialslike Sava.

sa: इति सर्वान् समुत्साह्य राज्ञस्तांश्चेदिपुङ्गवः। यज्ञोपघाताय ततः सोऽमन्त्रयत राजभिः॥
en: Having thus stirred up the kings, that best of the Chedis (Shishupala) began to consult with them how to obstruct the completion of the sacrifice.

sa: अज्ञो जन्तुरनीशोऽयमात्मनः सुखदुःखयोः। ईश्वरप्रेरितो गच्छेत् स्वर्ग नरकमेव च॥
en: Ignorant as they are, creatures are not masters of their own happiness or misery; dispatched by the Providence they either go to heaven or hell.

sa: संयन्ता सहदेवस्तु धौम्यो ब्रह्मविदुत्तमः। धर्मार्थकुशला चैव द्रौपदी धर्मचारिणी॥
en: Sahadeva has administrative talents, Dhaumya is the best of all men learned in the Vedas, and the virtuous Draupadi is learned in Dharma and Artha.

sa: भयात् संस्तम्भितभुजः सृक्किणी लेलिहन् मुहुः। ततोऽब्रवीद् देवराजश्च्यवनं भयपीडितः॥ सोमाविश्विनावेतावद्यप्रभृति भार्गव भविष्यतः सत्यमेतद् वचो विप्रः प्रसीद मे॥
en: Licked the corner of his mouth when his arms were paralyzed. Being afflicted with fear, the celestials king thus spoke, O son of Bhrigu, O Brahmanas, I truly tell you that from this day the two Ashvins will be entitled to receive the Soma juice. Therefore be merciful to me.

sa: पतिमन्वेषतीमेकां कृपणां शोककर्शिताम्। आश्वासय मृगेन्द्रेह यदि दृष्टस्त्वया नलः॥
en: O lord of animals! console me-who am, alone seeking my husband, distressed and woestricken-with the news of Nala if you have at all seen him.

sa: धर्मं चरामि सुश्रोणि नधर्मफलकारणात्। आगमाननतिक्रम्य सतां वृत्तमवेक्ष्य च॥
en: O fair-lady, I act piously not for getting the fruits of virtue but for not transgressing the Vedas and seeing the conduct of the pious.

sa: ते त्वां हंससधर्माणमपीमे वसुधाधिपाः। निहन्युर्भीष्म संक्रुद्धाः पक्षिणस्तं यथाण्डजम्॥
en: O Bhishma, your conduct is like that of the old swan. These kings might kill you in anger as the birds killed the old swan.

sa: गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षोभिरप्सरोभिश्च सेवितम्। किरातकिन्नरावासं शैलं शिखारेणां वरम्॥ विभेद तरसा गङ्गा गङ्गाद्वारं युधिष्ठिर। पुण्यं तत् ख्यायते राजन् ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्॥
en: O Yudhishthira, the spot where the Ganga rushes onward clearing that foremost of mountains (the Himalayas) frequented by the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Apsaras and inhabited by the Kiratas and the Kinnaras is called Gangadvara. O king this spot frequented by the celestials Rishis is considered very sacred.

sa: पश्यन्तस्ते नरव्याघ्रा रेमिरे तत्र पाण्डवाः। मधुस्रवफलं दिव्यं ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्॥
en: Seeing it frequented by the Brahmana Rishis and abounding in fruits dropping excellent honey, those foremost of men, the Pandavas, were filled with great delight.

sa: संचयेन तथाल्पेन भवन्त्याढ्यमदान्विताः। धनं विश्वासतो न्यस्तं मिथो भूयिष्ठशो नराः॥ हर्तु व्यवसिता राजन् पापाचारसमन्विताः। नैतदस्तीति मनुजा वर्तन्ते निरपत्रपाः॥
en: Having earned fortunes that are really small, men become intoxicated with the pride of wealth. O king, many men at the end of Yuga try to rob the wealth that has been secretly deposited with them by others out of trust. Full of sinful practices, they shamelessly declare, "they have nothing in deposit.”

sa: अभिद्रुत्य च भूयस्तावन्योन्यं बलदर्पितौ। भुजाभ्यां परिगृह्याथ चकर्षाते गजाविव॥
en: Defying each other from their great strength, they again rushed at each other and grasping each other by their arms they wrestled like two elephants.

sa: सायं प्रातश्च भगवान् दृश्यते हव्यवाहनः। मक्षिकाश्चादशंस्तत्र तपसः प्रतिघातिकाः॥
en: In the evening and in the morning the exalted carrier of libation (fire) was seen and flies bit men, thus obstructing the practice of austerities.

sa: तस्मिन् युगसलरान्ते सम्प्राप्ते चायुषः क्षये। अनावृष्टिर्महाराज जायते बहुवार्षिकी॥
en: O king, at the end of those thousands of years and when men become so short-lived, a draught takes place which extends for many years.

sa: तस्य शाईविनिर्मुक्तैर्बहुभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः। पुरं नासाद्यत शरैस्ततो मां रोष आविशत्॥
en: Many arrows, each capable of piercing to the very heart, discharged from my bow, did not reach his car. Thereupon I became filled with wrath.

sa: हतशेषास्ततः केचित् कालेया मनुजोत्तम। विदार्य वसुधां देवीं पातालतलमास्थिताः॥
en: O best of men, the remnant of those Kalkeyas that were not killed, took shelter in the nether regions after having rent the goddess Earth.

sa: नूनमद्यासि सम्पक्वो यथा ते मतिरीदृशी। दत्ता कृष्णापहरणे कालेनाद्भुतकर्मणा॥
en: Today that time has surely come, in as much as your mind has been led away by the wonder-performing fate to carry off Krishna (Draupadi).

sa: लोकवृत्ताद् राजवृत्तमन्यदाह बृहस्पतिः। तस्माद् राज्ञाप्रमत्तेन स्वार्थश्चिन्त्यः सदैव हि॥
en: Brihaspati has said that the usage of kings are different from those of common people. Therefore, kings should always look to their interest with vigilance.

sa: चत्वारः पाण्डवा वीरा गन्धर्वाश्च सहस्रशः। रणे संन्यपतन् राजंस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: There were but four Pandavas heroes; on the other hand there were thousands of Gandharvas. Therefore, O king, the battle that was fought was extraordinary.

sa: तदहं शरवर्षेण महता प्रत्यवारयम्। शस्त्रवर्षं महद् राजन् विद्याबलमुपाश्रितः॥
en: Thereupon, O king, availing myself of the strength of my knowledge (in arms), I warded off that shower of weapons by mighty discharges of arrows;

sa: युधिष्ठिरनियोगात् स जगामामितविक्रमः। शक्रं सुरेश्वरं द्रष्टुं देवदेवं च शंकरम्॥ दिव्यं तद्धनुरादाय खङ्गं च कनकत्सरुम्। महाबलो महाबाहुरर्जुनः कार्यसिद्धये॥ दिशं [दीची कौरव्यो हिमवच्छिखरं प्रति। ऐन्द्रिः स्थिरमना राजन् सर्वलोकमहारथः॥
en: At the command of Yudhishthira that immeasurably powerful hero set out to meet the chief of the celestials, Shakra and the god of gods, Shankara (Shiva). Taking up the excellent bow and the sword with the golden hit, in order to accomplish his purpose, the greatly powerful and the mighty-armed Arjuna. That descendant of Kuru, set out northward towards the summit of the Himalayas. O king, that son of Indra (Arjuna) of calm mind, that greatest car-warrior of all the world.

sa: स सर्वान् म्लेच्छनृपतीन् सागरानूपवासिनः। करमाहारयामास रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: From all the kings of the Mlecchas who lived on the coast of these, he exacted tribute in the shape of various gems and jewels.

sa: इदं द्वैतवनं नाम सरः पुण्यजलोचितम्। बहुपुष्पफलं रम्यं नानाद्विजनिषेवितम्॥
en: Here is the lake called Dvyaitavana, resorted to by the pious, abounding in many flowers and fruits, charming and inhabited by birds of diverse species.

sa: सोऽगच्छत् पर्वतांस्तात तपोधननिषेवितान्। दिव्यं हैमवतं पुण्यं देवजुष्टं परंतपः॥
en: O child, that chastiser of foes passed over many mountains inhabited by the ascetics; and (at last) he reached the sacred and the celestials Himalayas.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां परिभवाद् वातापिः सुदुरात्मवान्॥ अगस्त्यमृषिमासाद्य जीर्णः क्रूरो महासुरः।
en: Owing to his disregard of the Brahmanas, the evil-minded Vatapi, the crooked, but great Asura, having advanced to the sage, Agastya, was digested by him.

sa: दर्शयस्व महाराज मार्ग केन व्रजाम्यहम्। त्वदर्थमवतीर्णास्मि पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते॥
en: "O great king, show me the way by which I am to go. O ruler of earth, for your sake I have descended on carth."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा वदति वार्ष्णेयेधर्मराजे च भारता अथ पश्चात् तपोवृद्धो बहुवर्षसहाधृक्॥ प्रत्यदृश्यतधर्मात्मा मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः। अजरश्चामरश्चैव रूपौदार्यगुणान्वितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O Bharata, when the descendant of the Vrishnis and the Dharmaraja were thus conversing, the high-souled Markandeya, of great devotion, grown wise by austerities, who had lived many thousands of years, was seen to approach (there). Being immortal and without signs of senility, endued with beauty and magnanimity.

sa: पादेन हसतेधर्मो रक्ततां याति चाच्युतः। सत्यप्रवृत्ताश्च नराः क्रियाधर्मपरायणाः॥
en: (In this age) virtue decreased by a quarter and Narayana assumed a red colour. Men practised truth and devoted themselves to religion and religious rites.

sa: स्वायम्भुवेषु धर्मेषु शास्त्रे चौशनसे कृते। बृहस्पतिमते चैव लोकेषु प्रतिचारिते॥ युष्मत्कृतमिदं शास्त्रं प्रजापालो वसुस्ततः। बृहस्पतिसकाशाद् वै प्राप्स्यते द्विजसत्तमाः॥
en: After the publication of his work by the Self-born Manu and of that by Ushanas, and after the publication of the work also by Brihaspati, this science composed by you will be acquired by king Vasu. Indeed, you foremost of twice-born ones, that king will acquire this knowledge of this work from Brihaspati.

sa: स्वायम्भुवः क्रतुश्चापि पुत्रार्थमभवत् पुरा॥ आविश्य योगेनात्मानं त्रीणि वर्षशतान्यपि।
en: Concentrating his mind in Yoga, the Selfcreate Brahman, in days of yore, made a sacrifice for three hundred years, with the object of getting children.

sa: अथ यन्मोहसंयुक्तं काये मनसि वा भवेत्। अप्रतय॑मविज्ञेयं तमस्तदुपधारयेत्॥
en: Whatever is full of error or stupefaction in either body or mind, and is inconceivable and mysterious, should be known as being outcome to Tamas.

sa: ततो धाराकुले काले सम्भ्रमन् नष्टचेतनः। शीतार्तस्तद् वनं सर्वमाकुलेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: While the rain fell in torrents, the flower lost his sense from fear. Trembling with cold and stricken with fear, he roamed through the forest.

sa: तेषामधिपतिस्त्वासीद् भीमो भीमपराक्रमः। देवतानां भयकरः स हतः शूलपाणिना॥
en: The dreadful king those Asuras, endued with terrific prowess, who had struck the gods with terror, was also killed by Mahadeva armed with the lance.

sa: ब्रह्माणं प्रविशस्वेति लोकसृष्ट्यर्थसिद्धये। ततस्तमीश्वरादिष्टा बुद्धिः क्षिप्रं विवेश सा॥
en: For the accomplishment of the work of creating all the words do you enter into Brahman!-Ordered thus by the Supreme Lord, Intelligence immediately entered Brahman.

sa: अथ नारायणस्तत्र नारदं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ सुखोपविष्टं विश्रान्तं कृतातिथ्यं सुखस्थितम्।
en: Then seeing Narada refreshed from fatigue and seated at his ease and well-pleased with the rites of hospitality he had received, Narayana said these words.

sa: न जानपदिकं दुःखमेकः शोचितुमर्हति। अशोचन् प्रतिकुर्वीत यदि पश्येदुपक्रमम्॥
en: One should not only grieve for a sorrow that affects a whole community. Without grieving, should, if he finds opportunity, seek to use a remedy.

sa: श्रुतशीले समाज्ञाय वृत्तिमस्य प्रकल्पयेत्। अथैनं परिरक्षेत पिता पुत्रमिवौरसम्॥
en: Having learnt a Brahmana's learning and conduct, the king should provide for his living and protect him as a father protects his own begotten son.

sa: प्राप्ते प्रजाविसर्गे वै सप्तमे पद्मसम्भवे। नारायणो महायोगी शुभाशुभविवर्जितः॥ ससृजे नाभितः पूर्वं ब्रह्माणममितप्रभः। ततः स प्रादुरभवदथैनं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: On the occasion of the seventh creation, viz., that which was due to the primeval Lotus, Narayana, gifted, with the austerest penances, getting over both good and evil, and possessed of peerless splendour, at first created Brahman, from his navel. After Brahman had come into being, Narayana addressed him, saying,

sa: पितॄन् देवातिथींश्चैव यथावत् तेऽभ्यपूजयन्। अवशेषाणि चाश्नन्ति नित्यं सत्यतपोधृताः॥
en: They duly adored Pitris, gods and guests, and ate every day what was left after pleasing these. They were firmly devoted to truth and penances.

sa: स्वर्ण्यमारोग्यमायुष्यं धन्यं वेदेन सम्मितम्। नास्य विनं विकुर्वन्ति दानवा यक्षराक्षसाः। पिशाचा यातुधाना वा गुह्यका भुजगा अपि॥ यः पठेत शुचिः पार्थ ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। अभग्नयोगो वर्षं तु सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: This hymn leads to heaven. It removes disease and bestows long life. This is worthy of the highest praise, and is consistent with the Vedas. That person, O Partha, who recites this hymn with a pure heart observing the vow of celibacy, and with his senses under restraint, regularly for one whole year, succeeds in acquiring the fruits of a horse sacrifice, Danavas and Yakshas and Rakshasas and Pishachas and Yatudhanas and Guhyakas and snakes can do no harm to him.

sa: जगत्स्रष्टुमना देवो हरिनारायणः स्वयम्। चिन्तयामास पुरुषं जगत्सर्गकरं प्रभुम्॥
en: The illustrious Narayana, otherwise called Hari, when he was bent upon Creation, thought of a Being who would be powerful enough to create the universe.

sa: पृषदश्वाद् भरद्वाजो द्रोणस्तस्मात् कृपस्ततः। ततस्त्वं भ्रातृभिः सार्धं परमासिमवाप्तवान्॥
en: Prishadashva gave it to Bharadwaja, and Bharadwaja to Drona. Drona gave it to Kripa. Kripa gave that best of swords to you and your brothers.

sa: अनूच्यमानास्तु पुनस्ते मन्यन्तु महाजनात्। गुणवत्तरमात्मानं स्वेन मानेन दर्पिताः॥
en: Puffed up with a sense of their own importance, these men, when none stops them, consider themselves to be superior to men of real distinction.

sa: विशोको निर्ममः शान्तः प्रसन्नात्मा विमत्सरः। षड्भिर्लक्षणवानेतैः समग्रः पुनरेष्यति॥
en: One endued with those six qualities, viz., contentment, sorrowlessness, freedom from fetters, peacefulness, cheerfulness, and freedom from envy, is sure to become full or complete.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव तत् तेजो व्याप्य सर्वा दिशो दश॥ प्रशान्तं दिक्षु सर्वासु देवदेवस्य मायया। अथापश्यं स्थितं स्थाणुं भगवन्तं महेश्वरम्॥
en: That energy, however, did not pervade every side for a long time, for soon, through the illusion of that god of gods, the horizon became clear. I then saw the illustrious Sthanu or Maheshvara, seated on the back of his bull, of blessed and sweet appearance and loO king like a smokeless fire.

sa: नाभिरज्यति कस्मिश्चिन्नानर्थे न परिग्रहे। नाभिरज्यति चैतेषु व्यर्थत्वाद् रागरोषयोः॥
en: I never experience love for my wife or hate for my enemies. Indeed, I keep aloof from both, making the fruitlessness of attachment and anger.

sa: तस्माच्चोत्तिष्ठते शब्दः सर्वलोकेश्वरात् प्रभोः। आकाशं युज्यते येन ततस्तिष्ठत्यसंवृतम्॥
en: It is from that powerful Lord of the entire universe that that Sound has arisen. It belongs to Ether, which, therefore, exists uncovered and unconfined.

sa: ततः सम्पूजयामास काश्यपो हरिवाहनम्। अनुज्ञातस्तु तेनाथ प्रविवेश स्वमालयम्॥
en: Kashyapa then adored that god having the best of horses to carry him. Receiving afterwards with the god's permission, the Bralunana returned to his house.

sa: मूर्तिमन्ति तथाऽस्त्राणि सर्वतेजोमयानि च। मया दृष्टानि गोविन्द भवस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: I also saw, O Govinda, the weapons in their embodied forms and fraught with every sort of energy, that belong to Bhava of peerless prowess.

sa: क्षेत्रं पुरुषकारस्तु दैवं बीजमुदाहृतम्। क्षेत्रबीजसमायोगात् ततः सस्यं समृद्ध्यते॥
en: One's own deeds are like the soil, and Destiny is compared to the seed. The harvest grows from the union of the soil and seed.

sa: अपराजितश्च युद्धेषु तेजश्चैवानलोपमम्। एवं सहस्रशश्चान्यान् महादेवो वरं ददौ॥
en: You will be invincible in battle. Your energy shall be equal to that of Fire. Mahadeva gave me thousands of other boons at that time.

sa: यदा प्राज्ञो विरमते तदा सद्यः प्रणश्यति। परासुता क्रोधलोभादभ्यासाच्च प्रवर्तते॥ दयया सर्वभूतानां निर्वेदात् सा निवर्तते। अवद्यदर्शनादेति तत्त्वज्ञानाच्च धीमताम्॥
en: Envy of others originates from between anger and covetousness. It disappears by mercy and knowledge of self. For mercy for all creatures, and for disregard for all worldly objects, it disappears. It also springs from seeing the weakness of other people. But in intelligent men it quickly disappears by virtue of true knowledge.

sa: स एष हि महाबाहुः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। अच्युतः पुण्डरीकाक्षः सर्वभूतादिरीश्वरः॥
en: Of mighty arms, He is the object of universal adoration. Incapable of deterioration, that lotus-eyed one is the origin of all beings and their lord.'

sa: ते वरेणाभिसम्पन्ना बलेन च मदेन च। नावबुध्यन्ति सम्मूढा विष्णुमव्यक्तदर्शनम्॥ वराहरूपिणं देवमधृष्यममरैरपि। एष वेगेन गत्वा हि यत्र ते दानवाधमाः॥ अन्तर्भूमिगता घोरा निवसन्ति सहस्रशः। शमयिष्यति तच्छ्रुत्वा जहषुः सुरसत्तमाः॥
en: Having obtained boons, and possessed of power, and elated with pride, those senseless wretches do not know that Vishnu of invisible form, that god incapable of being defeated by the very gods in a body, has assumed the form of a boar. That Supreme Deity, going to the spot where those wretched Danavas, of terrible mien, are living in thousands below the Earth, will kill them all! Hearing these words of the Grandfather, those foremost one among the deities were overjoyed.

sa: प्रसारयित्वेहाङ्गानि कूर्मः संहरते यथा। तद्वद् भूतानि भूतानामल्पीयांसि स्थवीयसाम्॥
en: As a tortoise stretches forth its legs and withdraws them again into itself, so the numberless creatures originate from (and enter) these five great essences.

sa: सभाण्डोपस्करं राजंस्तमासाद्य बकाधिपः॥ सम्परिष्वज्य सुहृदं प्रीत्या परमया युतः।
en: Coming to his friend Gautama who still bore on his shoulders the load of gold, the king of cranes embraced him and felt great joy.

sa: इह प्रजापतिः पूर्वं देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा। इष्टदेवतपसः पूता ब्रह्मलोकमुपाश्रिताः॥
en: Here, in days of yore, the very Creator and all the gods having performed proper penances, with the Rishis became cleansed and attained to Brahma.

sa: अजश्चाश्वश्च मेषश्च गौश्च पक्षिगणाश्च ये। ग्राम्यारण्याचौषधयः प्राणस्यानमिति श्रुतिः॥
en: Goat, horse, sheep, cow, all sorts of birds, domestic or wild, and herbs and plants, constitute the food of living creatures. We have heard this.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन् देवो हयशिरोधरः॥ जग्राह वेदानखिलान् रसातलगतान् हरिः।
en: Meanwhile, O king, the Supreme Lord with the equine head, otherwise called Hari, who was himself in the nether region, took up all the Vedas.

sa: तदयुक्तस्य ते मोक्षे योऽभिमानो भवेन्नृप। सुहृद्धिः संनिवार्यस्तेऽविरक्तस्येव भेषजम्॥
en: This your attempt to acquire Liberation is like the use of medicine by a patient who indulges in all sorts of forbidden food and practices.

sa: मानसं सर्वभूतेषु वर्तते वै शुभाशुभम्। अशुभेभ्य: सदाऽऽक्षिप्य शुभेष्वेवावतारयेत्॥
en: Good and evil thoughts are in the minds of all creatures. Withdrawing the mind from cvil thoughts, it should always be bent towards good thoughts.

sa: तेन सम्यग्गृहीतेन श्रेयांसं धर्ममाप्स्यसि॥ पुण्यदेशाभिगमन पवित्रं परमं स्मृतम्।
en: By following it duly, you are sure to acquire great merit and blessedness. Pilgrimage to sacred places has also been described to be highly purifying

sa: पञ्चविंशं महात्मानं न चासावपि बुध्यते॥ षड्विशं विमलं बुद्धमप्रमेयं सनातनम्। स तु तं पञ्चविंशं च चतुर्विंशं च बुध्यते॥
en: Indeed, because the twenty-fifth can comprehend the Unmanifest, he is, therefore, called Comprehender. He cannot, however readily, comprehened the twenty-sixth, which is pure, which is Knowledge without duality, which is immeasurable, and which is eternal. The twenty-sixth, however, can know both the Individual Soul and Nature, numbering the twenty-fifth and the twenty-fourth respectively.

sa: पुरा वृका भयंकरा मनुष्यदेहगोचराः। अभिद्रवन्ति सर्वतो यतस्व पुण्यशीलने॥
en: Very soon will those terrible wolves that live within your body, attack from all sides. Do you try, therefore, to achieve acts acts of righteousness.

sa: तथैव व्यक्तमात्मानमव्यक्तं प्रतिपद्यते। यतो नि:सरते लोको भवति व्यक्तसंज्ञकः॥
en: For this, the Manifest is fused into the Unmanifest or Supreme Soul from which the world comes into being and becomes what is called Manifest.

sa: प्रत्यापत्तिश्च यस्येह बालिशस्य न जायते। तस्यापि सुमहांस्तापः प्रस्थितस्योपजायते॥
en: That foolish man who does not succeed in following Renunciation in this world becomes stricken with great grief when he goes to the next world.

sa: अवतीर्य महीं तेऽथ चातुर्होत्रमकल्पयन्। संयाजयन्तो विप्रांश्च राजन्यांश्च विशस्तथा॥
en: Descending upon the Earth they celebrated the Agnishtoma and other sacrifices; and they began to officiate at the sacrifices of Brahinanas and Kshatriyas and Vaishyas.

sa: सर्वथैतदिदं श्रुत्वा खड्गसाधनमुत्तमम्। लभते पुरुषः कीर्ति प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: By hearing of this excellent story of the origin of the sword, a man acquires fame in this world and eternal happiness in the next.'

sa: मानसं सर्वभूतानां धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः। तस्मात् सर्वेषु भूतेषु मनसा शिवमाचरेत्॥
en: The objects that are the righteousness of all creatures is a quality of the mind. One should, therefore, in his hand, do good to all.

sa: तथैवान्नं ह्यहरहः सायंप्रातर्निरूप्यते। पशवश्चाथ धान्य च यज्ञस्याङ्गमिति श्रुतिः॥
en: Food again ought to be taken day after day morning and evening. Again the Shruti says that aniinals and grain form the limbs of Sacrifice.

sa: भवेत्तु मानुषेष्वेवं प्रायश्चित्तमनुत्तमम्। दानं वा दानशक्तेषु सर्वमेतत् प्रकल्पयेत्॥
en: Amongst men such expiation ranks foremost. The practice of charity has been sanctioned in all such cases for those that are able to practise charity.

sa: सनत्कुमारस्तु ततः श्रुत्वा प्राह वचोऽर्थवत्। विष्णोर्माहात्म्यसंयुक्तं दानवेन्द्राय धीमते॥
en: Hearing these words, Sanatkumara said to the following, fraught with grave sense, upon the pre-cminent greatness of Vishnu to the intelligent king of the Danavas.

sa: सचेतनं जीवगुणं वदन्ति स चेष्टते चेश्यते च सर्वम्। अतः परं क्षेत्रविदो वदन्ति। प्रावर्तयद् यो भुवनानि सप्त॥
en: The learned hold that the Soul had Consciousness and has the attributes of life. The Soul works and makes everything to work. Persons cognisant of the Soul say that the Soul is different from life. It is the Supreme Soul that has created the seven words and makes them works.

sa: धर्मात्मा कोषवांश्चापि देवराज इवापरः। सुवीरस्य तु पुत्रोऽभूत् सर्वसंग्रामदुर्जयः॥
en: Suvira too had a son who was invincible in battle, and who was the best of all warriors and known by the name of Sudurjaya.

sa: विराटस्य सभां गत्वा भूमिपालासनेष्वथ। निषेदुः पावकप्रख्याः सर्वे धिष्ण्येष्विवागनयः॥
en: Having entered the assembly hall of the king Virata, they sat on thrones reserved for kings and shone there like fire on the sacrificial altar.

sa: निविष्टान् पाण्डवांस्तत्र ज्ञात्वा मित्राणि भारत। अभिससुर्यथादेशं सबलाः सहवाहनाः॥
en: Knowing that the sons of Pandu were encamped there, O Bharata, his friends came from their respective countries along with their own forces and armies.

sa: विवाहार्थो न मे कश्चिदिमां प्राप्यातिसुन्दरीम्। एतामेवाहमादाय गमिष्यामि स्वमालयम्॥
en: I do not desire to marry if I can secure this exquisitely beautiful lady. Taking her with me I shall go back to my house.

sa: इममुत्पथि वर्तन्तं पापं पापानुबन्धिनम्। वाक्यानि सुहृदां हित्वा त्वमप्यस्यानुवर्तसे॥
en: Instead of listening to the advice of your well-wishers, you too follow him, who is established on this unrighteous path and whose surroundings are sinful.

sa: एवं विष्णुबलाक्रान्तो गर्वनाशमुपागतः। गरुडो बलवान् राजन् वैनतेयो महायशाः॥
en: In this way was the haughty Garuda the son of Vinata and great renown, cured of his vanity, being overpowered by the might of Vishnu.

sa: ममेह भीम कैकेयी रूपाभिभवशङ्कया। नित्यमुद्विजते राजा कथं नेयादिमामिति॥
en: O Bhima, Kaikeyi, fearing that the king might take a fancy for me for my beauty, tries how to send me away from this place.

sa: सर्वे वेदविदो मुख्या यतयो मुनयस्तथा। आसेदुस्ते यथान्यायं पुनर्दर्शनकाझया॥
en: And all those foremost of Yatis and Munis, versed in the Vedas, exceedingly desirous of again beholding the Pandavas went back to their respective homes.

sa: संकुला च तदा भूमिश्चतुरङ्गबलान्विता। बलानि तेषां वीराणामागच्छन्ति ततस्ततः॥
en: And the earth at time became thronged with the four elements of the army. The armies of those heroes began to pour from all quarters.

sa: देवाश्चापि यदावाचन सूतके त्वां धनंजय॥ सहस्राक्षादनवरः कुन्ति पुत्रस्तवेति वै। उत्तरे पारियात्रे च जगुर्भूतानि सर्वशः॥ विप्रणष्टां श्रियं चैषामाहर्ता पुनरञ्जसा। नास्य जेता रणे कश्चिदजेता नैष कस्यचित्॥
en: O Dhananjaya, when you were born, the very gods themselves said, “O Kunti, this son of yours shall in no way be inferior to the thousand-eyed deity.” And in the northern r'aripatra mountain all the beings sang, “The prosperity these have been deprived of, by enemies, shall surely be recovered by this one. There shall be no vanquisher of him in battle and there shall be none whom he will not be able to conquer."

sa: मन्त्रभेदस्य षट् प्राज्ञो द्वाराणीमानि लक्षयेत्। अर्थसंततिकामश्च रक्षेदेतानि नित्यशः॥
en: Falls into a deep mire which he cannot cross. A wise man should have an eye on the following six means of secrets being divulged.

sa: स तु लब्ध्वान्तरं तूर्णमपायाज्जवनैर्हयैः। छिन्नवर्मध्वजः शूरो निकृत्तः परमेषुभिः॥
en: Securing an opportunity, he too, with his coat of mail and banner shattered, and wounded with great arrows, quickly went away on his swiftly-coursing horses.

sa: अविसंवादको दक्षः कृतज्ञो मतिमानृजुः। अपि संक्षीणकोशोऽपि लभते परिवारणम्॥
en: He, who has no deceit in him, who is skillful, grateful, intelligent and simple minded, gets friends even if his treasury has been drained off.

sa: गच्छन्नपि परां भूमिमपृष्टो ह्यनियोजितः। जात्यन्ध इव मन्येत मर्यादामनुचिन्तयन्॥
en: Holding even the highest office one should, until he is asked or commanded, regard himself as born-blind in consideration of the dignity of his position).

sa: अथवा मूलघातेन द्विषतां मधुसूदन। फलनिवृत्तिरिद्धा स्यात् तन्नृशंसतरं भवेत्॥
en: By putting an end to the enemy to the roots, O slayer of Madhu, we can attain to our object; but it is most cruel.

sa: तमभ्याशगतं राजा पदाति कुन्तिनन्दनः। अर्धचन्द्रेण बाणेन विव्याधोरसि धर्मराट्॥
en: Seeing the enemy approach so near and fighting on foot the pious king Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, pierced his breast with a crescent-shaped shaft.

sa: तमैलविलमासाद्य धर्मराजो व्यराजत॥ कुबेरसदनं प्राप्य ततो रत्नान्यवाप्य च।
en: That virtuous king shone resplendent even when in the abode of that Ailavila; going to the abode of Kubera he obtained gems and wealth therefrom.

sa: तौ युध्यमानौ संरब्धौ मृत्युपाशवशानुगौ। उपसृत्यापरिज्ञातो जग्राह मृगहा तदा॥
en: The slayer of animals then approaching those two fighting with each other, subject to the trap of death, without their knowledge caught hold of them.

sa: न चापि वयमत्यर्थं परित्यागेन कहिंचित्। कौरवैः शममिच्छामस्तत्र युद्धमनन्तरम्॥
en: We do not desire peace with the sons of Kuru, at the sacrifice of our own interest and therefore war is what we should follow.

sa: विचित्रमिदमाश्चर्यं मृगहन् प्रतिभाति मे। प्लमानौ हि खचरौ पदातिरनुधावसि॥
en: Slayer of animals, it seems to me wonderfully strange that you who move by your feet in this earth are following wanderers of the sky.

sa: मयाप्युपचितो धर्मस्ततोऽर्धं प्रतिगृह्यताम्। यस्माद् राजन् नराः सर्वे अपत्यफलभागिनः॥
en: By me too has religious merit been acquired; accept half of that, for, o king, all human beings enjoy the wealth earned by their children.

sa: तत्र पूर्वचतुर्वर्गो दम्भार्थमपि सेव्यते। उत्तरश्च चतुर्वर्गो नामहात्मसु तिष्ठति॥
en: The first four of these may be followed from motives of vanity; but the last four do not exist in those that are not great.

sa: छन्दांसि नाम क्षत्रिय तान्यथर्वा पुरा जगौ महर्षिसङ्घ एषः। छन्दोविदस्ते य उत नाधीतवेदा न वेदवेद्यस्य विदुर्हि तत्त्वम्॥
en: "Verses" is the name given, O Kshatriya, to what was recited by Atharvan in ancient days, in company with other great Rishis. Those who have read the Vedas and yet do not know the Being that ought to be known are not to be regarded as conversant with those verses.

sa: अशिवेनातिवामोरूरजलं नेत्रवारिणा। स्तनावपतितौ बाला संहतावभिवर्षती॥ उवाच वाक्यं तं क्षुद्रं वैदेही पतिदेवता। असकृद् वदतो वाक्यमीदृशं राक्षसेश्वर॥ विषादयुक्तमेतत् ते मया श्रुतमभाग्यया। तद् भद्रसुख भद्रं ते मानसं विनिवर्त्यताम्॥
en: And that fair-hipped lady, the princess of Videha to whom her husband was as her god, drenching her solid breasts with copious flow of inauspicious tears which she incessantly shed, spoke these words to that mean wretch. “O lord of the Rakshasas, unfortunate as I am, I have been compelled to listen to such painful words repeatedly uttered by you. May you be blessed, you who take so much delight in sensual pleasure. Withdraw your mind (from me).

sa: तमुवाचाथ सक्रोधो रावणः परिभर्स्यन्॥ अकुर्वतोऽस्मद्वचनं स्यान्मृत्युरपि ते ध्रुवम्।
en: (On hearing Maricha) Ravana reproachfully replied to him in anger. "If you do not comply with my be hests, you shall surely meet with death."

sa: आचार्यपुत्रो यः शूरः सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि। अश्वत्थामेति विख्यातस्तेनासीत् संगरः कथम्॥
en: How is the battle was that of Ashvatthama with you, the son of your preceptor who was the best among the warriors and armed heroes.

sa: इदमम्भो गृहीत्वा तु राजराजस्य शासनात्। गुह्यकोऽभ्यागतः श्वेतात् त्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम॥
en: "O tormentor of foes, at the command of the king of kings, a Guhyaka has come (to you) from the Shveta mountains, with this water.

sa: समवेताम् कुरून् सर्वाढिागीषूनवजित्य वै। गास्तेषां क्षिप्रमादाय पुनरेष्याम्यहं पुरम्॥
en: Having vanquished all the Kurus who have come here for victory and quickly rescued the kine I shall come back to the city of Virata.

sa: नरनारायणौ यौ तौ तावेवार्जुनकेशवौ। विजानीहि महाराज प्रवीरौ पुरुषोत्तमौ॥
en: Nara and Narayana, as these two were, so are Arjuna and Keshava; know this O great king, that those two best among men are heroes.

sa: द्वाविमौ पुरुषव्याघ्र सूर्यमण्डलभेदिनौ। परिवाड् योगयुक्तश्च रणे चाभिमुखो हतः॥
en: These two, O best of men, pierce the orb of the sun viz. an itinerant versed in yoga and one slain when engaged in battle.

sa: भीष्मस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा भारद्वाजो महामनाः। धृतराष्ट्रमुवाचेदं राजमध्येऽभिपूजयन्॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja of large mind having heard the words of Bhishma spoke thus to Dhritarashtra, among the assembled kings after duly saluting him.

sa: अनेन विद्धो मातङ्गो महानेकेषुणा हतः। सुवर्णकक्षः संग्रामे दन्ताभ्यामगमन्महीम्॥
en: A huge elephant was pierced with a shaft and killed by him. That one of huge tusks, and bedecked with gold, fell down on earth.

sa: ततः सर्वाभिसारेण हरीणां वातरंहसाम्। भेदयामास लङ्कायाः प्राकारं रघुनन्दनः॥
en: Then the descendant of Raghu by the simultaneous exertions of all monkeys, fleet as the wind, caused the walls of Lanka to be broken down.

sa: ददृशे पार्थिवो रेणुर्जनितस्तेन सर्पता। दृष्टिप्रणाशो भूतानां दिवस्पृक् कुरुसत्तम॥
en: Or like a forest full of many trees moving through the sky. Then was seen the dust of the earth raise by the moving army.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतो गन्धर्वश्चित्रमद्भुतम्। शशंस देवराजाय चित्रसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: The chivalrous Gandharva Chitrasena was impressed highly with Arjuna and he said Indra, the king of gods in appreciation of his excellent and phenomenal war-craft.

sa: प्रकाशयात्मनाऽऽत्मानं दैत्यदानवसूदन। तेजः समाप्नुहि विभो देवराज्यं प्रशाधि च॥
en: O you slayer of Daityas and Danavas, hide no longer your ownself. O lord, assume your own strength and rule the kingdom of the gods.

sa: कृष्णग्रीवाश्च शकुना रक्तपादा भयानकाः। संध्याममिमुखा यान्ति तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: Birds, with black neck read feet, which are terrible looking, go towards the army, in the evening and these are the signs of a defeat.

sa: हृदयग्रहणीयानि राधेयं मधुसूदनः। यान्यप्रवीदमेयात्मा तानि मे शृणु भारत॥
en: And acceptable to the heart, which the slayer of Madhu, that one of immeasurable soul said to the son of Radha-hear from me, O Bharata.

sa: द्वाविमौ कण्टको तीक्ष्णौ शरीरपरिशोषिणौ। यश्चाधनः कामयते यश्च कुप्यत्यनीश्वरः॥
en: These two are like sharp thorns consuming the body viz. the man, who being poor, has desires and one, who thought powerless, is yet wrathful.

sa: कुरूणां शममिच्छन्तं यतमानं च केशव। विदित्वैतामवस्था मे नाभिशङ्कितुमर्हसि॥
en: Desirous of the peace of Kurus, I have lost my respect; 0 Keshava, knowing these circumstances it is not proper that you should suspect me.

sa: संकर्षणानुजः श्रीमान् महाबुद्धिर्जनार्दनः। तद् दृष्ट्वोपस्थितं युद्धं समासन्नं महात्ययम्॥
en: Was the younger brother of Sankarashana, Janardana of great intelligence, endued with great beauty. Then seeing that a great battle : was near at hand,

sa: ब्राह्मण्यो राजपुत्र्यश्च विशां दुहितरश्च याः। क्रीडन्त्योऽभिसमायान्ति पार्थं संनद्धमीक्षितुम्॥
en: The daughters of Brahmanas and of chieftains and of the Vaishyas, while playing, come to Partha to see him clad in a coat of mail.

sa: अधनस्याकृतार्थस्य त्यक्तस्य विविधैः फलैः। ऋणं धारयमाणस्य कुतः सुखमनीहया॥
en: What happiness can there be without hard exertion for him who is poor, unsuccessful, deprived of all the sweets of life and saddled with debts?

sa: उपाशाम्यद् रजो भौमं सर्वं व्याप्तं मरीचिभिः। दिव्यगन्धानुपादाय वायुर्योधानसेवत॥
en: The dust of the earth was removed and every where was permeated by the lustre. And carrying the divine odour the wind gratified the warriors.

sa: शेषेणैवास्य कार्यण प्रज्ञास्याम्यहमायुषः। सुपर्णस्य विधाते च प्रयतिष्यामि सत्तम॥
en: O best of your race, I shall try to foil the intentions of Suparna and as a last resource shall ascertain Sumukha's length of life.

sa: तस्याहं सर्वमेवैतद् भवतो व्यसनागमम्॥ प्रायोपवेशने चैव हेतुं विस्तरशोऽब्रुवम्।
en: I then fully informed him of the calamity that has befallen your worshipful self and of the cause of our resolve to die of starvation.

sa: सुमुखश्च मया सार्धं देवेशमभिगच्छतु। कार्यसंसाधनार्थाय स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु भुजंगम॥
en: Let Sumukha, along with myself, proceed to the lord of the gods for the attainment of this object and may you fare well, O serpent.

sa: विरोचन सुधन्वाऽयं प्राणानामीश्वरस्तव। सुधन्वन् पुनरिच्छामि त्वया दत्तं विरोचनम्॥
en: O Virochana, this Sudhanvan is now the lord of your life. O Sudhanvan, I desire it (the life) to be restored by you to Virochana.

sa: उच्चैराकाशमार्गेण हता:स्मस्तैः सुदुःखिताः। अथ नः सैनिकाः केचिदमात्याश्च महारथाः॥
en: We were overwhelmed with sorrow and we were being taken by them ihrough high skies. Our Thereupon some of soldiers and counsellers and great car-warriors.

sa: स्पर्श वेत्सि विदग्धस्त्वं कामधर्मविचक्षणः। स्त्रीणां प्रीतिकरो नान्यस्त्वत्समः पुरुषस्त्विह॥
en: I consider your touch as burning and you are an expert at gallantry. I do not see any other man like you favourite to women.

sa: अजातशत्रुरत्यर्थं भीमसेनवशानुगः। निकृतश्च मया पूर्वं सह सर्वैः सहोदरैः॥
en: Yudhishthira who has no enemies, too is greatly under the influence of Bhimasena-besides he had been persecuted by me before along with all his brothers.

sa: अत्र देवीं दितिं सुप्तामात्मप्रसवधारिणीम्। विगर्भामकरोच्छनो यत्र जातो मरुद्गणः॥
en: In this quarter seeing the goddess Diti, who bore a child, asleep, Shakra cut up the focus from which were born the group of Maruts.

sa: विराटदुपदाभ्यां च सपुत्राभ्यां समन्वितम्। केकयैर्वृष्णिभिश्चैव पार्थिवैः शतशो वृतम्॥
en: And by Virata and Drupada along with their sons, and by the Kaikeyas and Vrishnis and surrounded by the rulers of the earth by hundreds,

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वाष्परुद्धेन कण्ठेनायतलोचना। सरोद कृष्णा सोत्कम्पं सस्वरं बाष्पगद्गदम्॥
en: Saying this with voice choked with tears, Krishna of distended eyes began to weep aloud in convulsive sobs and with her eyes full of tears.

sa: दुपदस्याप्यभूत् सेना नानादेशसमागतैः। शोभिता पुरुषैः शूरैः पुत्रैश्चास्य महारथैः॥
en: And the army of the king of Drupada, assembled from several countries, was graced by heroic men and also by his sons of wonderful valour.

sa: प्रवीराः सर्वलोकस्य युवानः सिंहविक्रमाः। परिवार्य रथं शौरेरगच्छन्त परंतपाः॥
en: A large number of young men of the strength of lions, heroic chastisers of foes in the world surrounding the car of Shauri, followed him.

sa: शशंस रावणस्तस्मै तत् सर्वं रामचेष्टितम्। समासेनैव कार्याणि क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः॥
en: Ravana, whose heart was distracted with grief and anger, briefly told him of the acts of Rama and the steps that were to be taken.

sa: सख्यं वानरराजेन शक्रप्रतिमतेजसा। कृतवान् राघवः श्रीमांस्त्वदर्थे च समुद्यतः॥
en: The illustrious descendant of Raghu has contracted friendship with the king of the monkeys, as powerful as Shakra himself and is ready for your deliverance.

sa: तस्मिन् गृहीते विरथे विराटे बलवत्तरे। प्राद्रवन्त भयान्मत्स्यास्त्रिगर्तेरर्दिता भृशम्॥
en: After the powerful Virata, deprived of his car, had been taken captive, the Matsya's, greatly assailed by Trigartas, fled away to different directions in fear.

sa: स किलाक्षातिवापस्त्वं सभास्तारो मया वृतः। अथ राजासने कस्मादुपविष्टस्त्वलंकृतः॥
en: You were a player at dice and were appointed by me as a courtier. Why do you, adorned with ornaments, sit on a royal throne?”

sa: स वीक्षमाणस्तत् सैन्यं रामदर्शनकाक्षया अपश्यच्चापि सौमित्रिं धनुष्पाणिं व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Having observed (carefully) the monkey host with the desire of finding out Rama (among it) he saw Lakshmana stand (ready for fight), bow in hand.

sa: ततः प्राध्मापयच्छङ्ख भेरीशतनिनादिनम्। प्रचुक्षुभे बलं सर्वमुद्भूत इव सागरः॥
en: Drona then blew his conch, the sound of which resembled that of a hundred trumpets. And the whole army was agitated thereat like the ocean.

sa: वृद्धयोरन्धयोदृष्टिस्त्वयि वंशः प्रतिष्ठितः। त्वयि पिण्डश्च कीर्तिश्च संतानं चावयोरिति॥
en: You are the only support of these blind ones. The perpetuity of our line, our funeral oblations, our fame, our descendants, (all) depend on you."

sa: शुद्धात्मा गुणवान् पार्थः सत्यवान् नीतिमाशुचिः। तेजोराशिरसंख्येयो गृह्णीयादपि चक्षुषा॥
en: The pure-souled, accomplished, truthful, honest son of Pritha, conversant with policy, and a very collection of effulgence, is capable of consuming by his very look.

sa: द्रौपदी धर्मराजस्तु दृष्ट्वा धौम्यपुरस्कृताम्। माद्रीपुत्रेण वीरेण रथमारोपयत् तदा॥
en: Beholding Draupadi with Dhaumya walking before, the pious king Yudhishthira made her taken up on the car by the heroic Sahadeva, the son of Madri.

sa: वधे धृतो वेगवतः प्रमुञ्चन् नाहं प्रजाः किंचिदिहावशिष्ये। शान्ति लप्स्ये परमो ह्येष भाव: स्थिरो मम ब्रूहि गावल्गणे तान्॥
en: Bringing all my powers and by the aid of my work of destruction, shall I fling these weapons and leave no trace of those that come to the field; and then shall I obtain rest. Such a state of rest is excellent. This is my determination. Tell them this, O son of Gavalgani.

sa: हिरण्मयांश्च ते कुम्भान् राजतान् पार्थिवांस्तथा। ओषध्यः सर्वबीजानि सर्वरत्नानि वीस्थः॥ राजन्या राजकन्याश्चाप्यानयन्त्वाभिषेचनम्॥ षष्ठे त्वां च तथा काले द्रौपद्युपगमिष्यति।
